data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf amended the 2022 income tax assessment (dated 17 December 2024) because of changed employer data. The tax stays at €6,918.00, so there is no additional payment and no refund.
data.explanation: The tax office corrected your 2022 income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) after your employer reported changed data. The tax amount is the same as before (€6,918.00), so you owe nothing and get nothing back. You may file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree with the assessment; the app shows until when. If you agree, no action is needed. Keep the letter with your tax records. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
